checkpoint: G9.1 metadata, typed pools and accepted progress

executed_controls.name: pending plan is detached and write-once
executed_controls.observed: After binding original plan, mutation of the caller plan did not change Pending's context or digest. Rebinding with a different operation ID/context raised a write-once error and retained the original. Clearing plan raised and retained it; identical-value reassignment was a no-op.

executed_controls.name: uncertain outcome preserves pending state
executed_controls.observed: Passing client.RpcError(kind=outcome_unknown, http_status=200) to reject raised; pending plan/digest, accepted count, cursor, and reference usage stayed unchanged.

executed_controls.name: actual client receipt shape and operation ID
executed_controls.observed: A direct committed records receipt shaped as client.execute returns (result.operation_id/revision/records) advanced accepted progress when operation_id matched the saved plan. The source-derived old nested kind/result shape was not required.

executed_controls.name: committed target binding
executed_controls.observed: After accepting a first plan, attaching a same-model plan for a different store/actor was rejected before progress changed.

executed_controls.name: callback reference override and actual usage
executed_controls.observed: A rule changed a child reference from its provisional parent to a second, compatible supplied parent. Final fields contained the second ID and Proposal.usage counted the second typed parent/ID.

executed_controls.name: invalid callback reference override
executed_controls.observed: A well-formed but unavailable UUID override failed final reference validation instead of producing a proposal.

executed_controls.name: indexed reference paths
executed_controls.observed: A synthetic contract with required sources[0], optional absent sources[1], and an empty generated array produced exactly one anchored source; optional index 1 remained omitted. Usage identified the chosen parent ID.

executed_controls.name: quota and uncommitted-parent boundary
executed_controls.observed: Quota 1 with batch size 8 emitted one command. With a required child reference and no supplied anchor, the first batch included only its eligible parent; source inspection and the separate receipt control confirm the child becomes eligible only after parent acceptance.

executed_controls.name: not_observed does not reject
executed_controls.observed: A not_observed result raised and preserved accepted counts, cursor, usage, and exact pending work.

executed_controls.name: catalog snapshot and typed pool sampling
executed_controls.observed: Mutating the caller's source catalog after prepare left generated contract code and State.catalog at the prepared value. A NoPoolScan mapping whose values() raised still allowed proposal selection from a 2,000-ID supplied pool.

executed_controls.name: provider generation, heap flag, and output bound
executed_controls.observed: Public generate_values produced a valid row. A Node heap probe with the production 64 MiB old-space flag reported V8 heap_size_limit 167772160 bytes. A child that wrote indefinitely through _invoke hit the hard 2097153-byte file ceiling and returned 'output exceeds 2097152 bytes'.

executed_controls.name: pre-submission saved-plan validation
executed_controls.observed: A plan with changed commands, a consistent but wrong request/target model, and a 66,000-byte context each failed during Pending.plan assignment. The slot remained empty and a valid exact plan then bound. Mutating proposal.digest alone also failed before binding; after restoring the marker the original plan bound. A later different operation ID/context rebind was rejected, preserving the original plan and digest.

executed_controls.name: 64-command provider refill from two 32-value batches
executed_controls.observed: provider_batch_size=32 and batch_size=64 called the provider with [32,32], produced 64 commands, and left State provider cursor/buffer unchanged before acknowledgement. A direct committed receipt advanced accepted count to 64, provider cursor to 64, and left an empty buffer.

executed_controls.name: partial provider refill failure is atomic in caller state
executed_controls.observed: The first 32-value provider call succeeded; the second returned 31 instead of 32. Proposal failed after calls [32,32], while accepted count, proposal cursor, provider cursor and buffer stayed at zero/empty and pending stayed None.

executed_controls.name: malformed generated-format schema error
executed_controls.observed: After the provider guard fix, _preflight(format=[]) raises PopulationValueError with a path-specific expected-text message rather than raw TypeError.
